content:
Well, I l{a}ive down the road from the c{G}olliery gate,
and the s{a}iren of the shift is the s{G}ound I hate,
d{C}on't be sick and d{G}on't be late;
there is n{a}o other w{G}ork in the v{a}illage.

When the dust and the grime make a man retire,
and the son comes up for the chance of hire,
working in the dark just to feed your fire;
there is no other work in the village.

Though Bilston is better than most they say,
I would do anything to keep my son away.
Jobs like that don't come each day,
there is no other work in the village.
title: The Colliery Gate
